name: Floating Contact Button for MAX and Telegram
author: Alexander Alekseenko

sections.description:
Floating Contact Button for MAX and Telegram adds a floating button to your WordPress site,
so visitors can instantly contact you via Telegram Messenger or MAX Messenger — completely free.

📌 Why Telegram?
Telegram has over 1 billion users worldwide and is one of the fastest-growing messaging apps.
Adding a Telegram button makes it easy for customers to reach you instantly.

📌 Why MAX?
This plugin is the first WordPress integration for the new Russian messenger MAX.
Whether you want to test it or provide your users with an alternative, the button makes it seamless.

✨ Features:
– Floating contact button with icons for Telegram and MAX
– Free to use — no hidden fees
– Lightweight and privacy-friendly (no external servers, no tracking)
– Fully customizable (position, size, style)
– Easy setup, no coding required
– Multilingual ready

🚀 Boost engagement, support, and conversions by giving your visitors instant access to your chat.

⚠️ Disclaimer:
This plugin is developed independently and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Telegram Messenger, MAX Messenger, or their respective owners.

Advanced: Custom CSS

You can fully control the button position and style with CSS.
The plugin renders a wrapper and items with the following selectors:
– #max-button-wrapper (container)
– .max-button-item (each messenger button)

Examples:

/* Move the button to the left side, 32px from edges */

max-button-wrapper {

position: fixed;
left: 32px;
right: auto;
bottom: 32px;
z-index: 9999; /* keep above theme elements */
}

/* Increase overall size of the circle buttons */

max-button-wrapper .max-button-item {

width: 56px;
height: 56px;
}

/* Tweak the icon size inside */

max-button-wrapper .max-button-item img {

width: 26px;
height: 26px;
}

/* Hide on small screens if needed */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
#max-button-wrapper { display: none; }
}

/* Add soft shadow */

max-button-wrapper .max-button-item {

box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
}

/* Optional: subtle pulse to attract attention */
@keyframes fcb-pulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.06); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

max-button-wrapper .max-button-item–telegram { animation: fcb-pulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/floating-contact-button-for-max-and-telegram
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open Settings > Contact Button and enter your Telegram or MAX links
  4. Save changes — the button will appear on your site
sections.faq:
Can I use only Telegram without MAX?

Yes. Just add your Telegram link and leave the MAX field empty.

Does this plugin track my users?

No. There are no external servers, no tracking, and no hidden analytics.

Can I customize the button style?

Yes. You can change position, size, and design through CSS.
